Method of Attack: Hosting lure documents and phishing pages on public cloud services to steal Office 365 credentials
Using multiple legitimate cloud services (Google Drive, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM Cloud) to host phishing landing pages and lure documents
Phishing pages asking for Office 365 or organization login credentials
Using Outlook login pop-up window to complete login process
Loading phishing page resources from third-party domains (e.g., prvtsmtp.com) to hide attacker domain
Using Google Cloud Functions to run code in the cloud and load phishing page resources without revealing attacker domain
Attack Vector: Phishing via malicious PDF documents hosted on cloud services
Phishing landing pages hosted on cloud platforms
Redirects from lure documents to phishing pages
Use of legitimate cloud service URLs to evade detection
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious PDF document hosted on Google Drive
Domains resolving to IP 31.28.168.4 or same netblock
Use of Google Cloud Functions for phishing page resource loading
